functions.description: Parse a monetary amount in dollars from raw text, handling currency sign, thousands separators and scale words such as k, thousand, million, bn and billion.
inputs: raw text of a monetary amount such as $379,000 or $0.42 million
outputs: monetary amount in dollars as exact decimal

functions.description: Parse a whole number of years or a useful life from raw text, handling digits and number words.
inputs: raw text of a whole number such as 8 years or 11-year life or eleven years

functions.description: Compute the annual double-declining-balance rate as two divided by the useful life in years.
inputs: the useful life in years as a positive whole number
outputs: annual double-declining-balance rate as exact fraction

functions.description: Apply one year of double-declining-balance depreciation to a beginning book value, capping the charge so the ending book value does not fall below salvage value.
outputs: depreciation charged this year in dollars

functions.description: Iterate double-declining-balance yearly depreciation with a salvage-value floor from the original cost for the elapsed years and return the unrounded book value.
outputs: book value after the elapsed years in dollars unrounded

functions.description: Compute the book value after a given number of elapsed years under double-declining-balance depreciation that never falls below salvage value.
inputs: the number of years elapsed since the asset was acquired, as a whole number of years
the original cost of the asset in dollars with currency unit
the useful life of the asset in years
the estimated salvage value of the asset in dollars with currency unit
outputs: book value after the elapsed years in dollars

functions.description: Parse a money amount from raw text with currency symbols, separators and scale suffixes into an exact Decimal dollar amount.
inputs: the money amount as raw text

functions.description: Parse a percentage rate from raw text such as '7.5%' or '7.5 percent' into an exact Decimal annual rate as a fraction.
inputs: the percentage rate as raw text
outputs: annual rate as a decimal fraction

functions.description: Parse a loan term from raw text (digits or number words, in years or months) into a term in years and a term in months.
inputs: the loan term with unit as raw text

functions.description: Determine the number of compounding periods per year from a frequency description such as monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, weekly, biweekly or daily.
inputs: the compounding and payment frequency description as raw text

functions.description: Compute the periodic interest rate (annual rate divided by periods per year) and the total number of payments (periods per year times term in years).
inputs: annual rate as a decimal fraction

functions.description: Compute the growth factor (1+r)^n and the unrounded level periodic annuity payment from principal, periodic rate and number of payments, treating a zero rate as principal divided by number of payments.
Round the periodic payment to the cent with half-up rounding and compute total interest as the rounded payment times the number of payments minus the principal.
Solve a fixed-rate amortizing loan: compute the level periodic payment and the total interest paid over the term, from the principal, the annual nominal rate, the compounding frequency and the term.
inputs: the loan principal amount in dollars
the annual nominal interest rate as a percentage
the compounding and payment frequency description

entry_points.text: Using the double-declining-balance method, find the book value after ●1 of an asset that cost ●2, has a ●3 and a ●4 salvage value.

params.description: the number of years elapsed since the asset was acquired, as a whole number of years
params.validity_range: Non-negative whole number of years. Values at or beyond the useful life give a book value equal to salvage value, so the value is meaningful for any non-negative integer and is floored at salvage.

params.description: the original cost of the asset in dollars with currency unit
params.validity_range: Positive monetary amount strictly greater than the salvage value, since depreciation is based on cost minus salvage.

params.description: the useful life of the asset in years
params.validity_range: Positive whole number of years. A life of at least 2 years gives a DDB rate of 2/life that does not exceed 100 percent; a life of 1 year gives a 200 percent rate, which the salvage floor still bounds.

params.description: the estimated salvage value of the asset in dollars with currency unit
params.validity_range: Non-negative monetary amount that is strictly less than the original cost, so that there is a depreciable base above salvage.
